block.description: FireHydrant environments are used to tag incidents with where they are occurring.

step_strategy.description: The strategy for handling steps in the escalation policy. Can be 'static' or 'dynamic_by_priority'.

repetitions.description: Number of repetitions for this priority level

block.description: Handoff step for this priority level
Priority-specific policies for dynamic escalation policies

effective_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for when the schedule update should take effect. If not provided or if the time is in the past, the update will take effect immediately.

rotation_description.description: Description of the schedule's primary rotation. Set this to override the default (which inherits the schedule's description). Tracked in state.

rotation_name.description: Name of the schedule's primary rotation (the rotation FireHydrant creates alongside the schedule itself). Set this to override the default (which inherits the schedule's name). Tracked in state; mutations are sent to the schedule's PATCH endpoint.

built_in.description: Whether this is a built-in role

permissions.description: List of permission slugs assigned to this role

slug.description: The slug for the role. If not provided, will be auto-generated from name

updated_at.description: When the role was last updated

effective_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for when the schedule update should take effect. If not provided or if the time is in the past, the update will take effect immediately.

user_id.description: The ID of the user to add to the rotation. You can use the firehydrant_user data source to look up a user by email/name. Leave empty to create an unassigned slot in the rotation.

deduplication_expiry.description: Duration for deduplicating similar alerts (ISO8601 duration format e.g., 'PT30M', 'PT2H', 'P1D')

built_in.description: Whether this is a built-in role

permissions.description: List of permission slugs assigned to this role

updated_at.description: When the role was last updated

id.description: FireHydrant internal ID for the Slack channel.

slack_channel_id.description: ID of the channel, provided by Slack.

block.description: The `firehydrant_slack_channel` data source allows access to the details of a Slack channel.
